messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "can cause bleeding in mother if taken within 1 week before childbirth"
set: ["can cause bleeding in mother if taken within 1 week before childbirth", "may cause bleeding in mother or unborn baby", "may cause medical problems in mother and baby", "may increase risk of severe bleeding after childbirth", "could cause death if taken by others", "can cause premature birth", "can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "may cause jaundice or bleeding problems in a newborn", "can cause low birth weight", "stopping abruptly can cause uncontrolled pain", "opioids can cause sudden withdrawal symptoms", "use within 7 days before MAO inhibitor", "one dose can cause death if used accidentally or improperly", "can cause serious and life-threatening irregular heartbeat", "prolonged use during pregnancy can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "too much thyroid hormone can cause angina"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
